"""Deterministic offline acceptance kept outside the executor worktree.
AST extraction avoids importing API/auth code and tests production functions.
"""
import argparse,ast,contextlib,copy,hashlib,importlib.util,io,json,math,os,re,sys,tempfile,types,uuid,traceback
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter
def extract(path,names,namespace):
    tree=ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    functions={x.name:x for x in tree.body if isinstance(x,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}
    assert all(n in functions for n in names),'MISSING_PRODUCTION_FUNCTION'
    selected=set(names)
    # Evaluate production helper dependencies as well: adding a legitimate
    # helper must not cause the isolated AST harness to invent a NameError.
    while True:
        found={n.id for key in selected for n in ast.walk(functions[key]) if isinstance(n,ast.Name) and isinstance(n.ctx,ast.Load) and n.id in functions}
        if found<=selected:break
        selected|=found
    nodes=[x for x in tree.body if isinstance(x,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and x.name in selected]
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),str(path),'exec'),namespace)
    return namespace
@contextlib.contextmanager
def fixture_dir(parent,prefix):
    # Python 3.13 tempfile's Windows mode=0700 ACL does not grant this sandbox
    # SID access. Ordinary workspace directories inherit existing permissions.
    # Keep fixture evidence rather than changing ACLs or deleting failed data.
    directory=parent/(prefix+uuid.uuid4().hex);directory.mkdir()
    yield str(directory)
def check(work):
    results=[]
    def case(name,fn):
        t=perf_counter()
        try:fn();result=dict(name=name,passed=True,error=None)
        except Exception as e:result=dict(name=name,passed=False,error=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
        result['wall_ms']=(perf_counter()-t)*1000;results.append(result)
    fgr=work/'llm_verifier/fine_grained_reward.py'
    temp_root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'evidence/verifier_private/tmp';temp_root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    ns=dict(math=math,re=re,GRANULARITY=20,USAGE=types.SimpleNamespace(record=lambda x:None),SCALE=dict(valid_tokens={**{chr(65+i):float(20-i) for i in range(20)},**{chr(97+i):float(20-i) for i in range(20)}}))
    extract(fgr,['_score_tags_by_prefill','_find_tag_logprobs','extract_score'],ns)
    for field in ['content','reasoning','reasoning_content','logprobs']:
        def fn(field=field):
            message=types.SimpleNamespace(content=None)
            if field!='logprobs':setattr(message,field,' B ')
            pos=types.SimpleNamespace(token=' B',top_logprobs=[types.SimpleNamespace(token='B',logprob=math.log(.8)),types.SimpleNamespace(token='T',logprob=math.log(.2))])
            choice=types.SimpleNamespace(message=message,logprobs=types.SimpleNamespace(content=[pos]))
            calls=[]
            def create(**kw):calls.append(kw);return types.SimpleNamespace(choices=[choice])
            client=types.SimpleNamespace(chat=types.SimpleNamespace(completions=types.SimpleNamespace(create=create)))
            text,tokens,lps=ns['_score_tags_by_prefill'](client,'offline',[],'',[ '<score>' ],20)
            assert '<score>B</score>' in text,text
            assert tokens[1]=='B'
            assert calls[0]['max_tokens']==1 and calls[0]['extra_body']['continue_final_message'] is True
            assert math.isclose(ns['extract_score'](text,tokens,lps,'<score>'),.8*18/19,abs_tol=1e-9)
        case('T01_prefill_'+field,fn)
    def precedence():
        message=types.SimpleNamespace(content='C',reasoning='B',reasoning_content='A');choice=types.SimpleNamespace(message=message,logprobs=None)
        client=types.SimpleNamespace(chat=types.SimpleNamespace(completions=types.SimpleNamespace(create=lambda **kw:types.SimpleNamespace(choices=[choice]))))
        text,_,_=ns['_score_tags_by_prefill'](client,'offline',[],'',['<score>'],20)
        assert '<score>C</score>' in text,text
    case('T01_content_precedence',precedence)
    for empty in ['', ' ', '\t']:
        def fn(empty=empty):
            wanted=[('A',math.log(.9)),('T',math.log(.1))]
            assert ns['_find_tag_logprobs'](['<score>',empty,'A','</score>'],[[('x',0)],wanted,[('bad',0)],[('close',0)]],'<score>')==wanted
        case('T01_tag_nonadvancing_'+repr(empty),fn)
    def fallback():
        assert ns['extract_score']('<score>A</score>',None,None,'<score>')==1
        assert ns['extract_score']('<score>T</score>',None,None,'<score>')==0
        assert ns['extract_score']('<score>A</score><score>T</score>',None,None,'<score>')==0
    case('T01_literal_last_verdict',fallback)
    def registry():
        modname='isolated_benchmark_'+str(id(work));spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(modname,work/'llm_verifier/benchmarks.py');mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules[modname]=mod

Usage: orca <command> [options]

Startup:
  open                      Launch Orca and wait for the runtime to be reachable
  serve                     Start a headless Orca runtime server
  status                    Show app/runtime/graph readiness

Diagnostics:
  diagnostics memory        Collect a memory snapshot for Orca and managed terminals

Agent Discovery:
  agent-context             Print the machine-readable command schema for agents

Agent Sessions:
  search                    Search the full text of agent sessions on one Orca host

Accounts:
  account add               Add a managed agent account on this Orca host
  account list              List managed agent accounts on this Orca host
  account select            Select an OpenCode or Devin account for new launches
  account rm                Remove an OpenCode or Devin account and its private data

Skills:
  skills installed          List installed skill selectors
  skills share              Publish selected skills behind one unlisted link
  skills list               List version-matched skill guides bundled with this Orca CLI
  skills get                Print a version-matched skill guide as Markdown
  skills install            Install bundled Orca skills globally via the community skills CLI
  skills update             Update already-installed Orca skills via the community skills CLI

Hosts:
  host list                 List targetable machines and how to name each one

Environments:
  environment add           Save a remote Orca runtime from a pairing code
  environment list          List saved remote Orca runtimes
  environment show          Show one saved remote Orca runtime
  environment rm            Remove a saved remote Orca runtime

Environment Recipes:
  vm recipe doctor          Validate a per-workspace environment recipe

Automations:
  automations list          List scheduled Orca automations
  automations show          Show one Orca automation
  automations create        Create a scheduled Orca automation
  automations edit          Edit an Orca automation
  automations remove        Remove an Orca automation and its run history
  automations run           Run an Orca automation now
  automations runs          List automation run history

Projects:
  project list              List durable projects known to Orca
  project setups            List project host setups

  project setup-clone       Make a project available on a host by cloning a repository

  project setup-update      Update project host setup metadata
  project setup-delete      Remove a project host setup

  worktree show             Show one worktree
  worktree current          Show the Orca-managed worktree for the current directory
  worktree create           Create a new Orca-managed worktree
  worktree set              Update Orca metadata for a worktree
  worktree rm               Remove a worktree from Orca and git
  worktree ps               Show a compact orchestration summary across worktrees
